section.name: Using SList
section.p:
The SList view component binds the SList to two get methods in the model.
an ArrayList of value objects to populate the entire list
a specific "selected" instance of the member value objects, so that the model can be aware of which object is selected in the view
The SList updates its selected item in the model via the Scope framework. The SList can also issue a Control when the selection is changed, which may be handled in the Controller component.
